description: Find the web pages that show this image, with the copies of it each page uses, ranked by how prominent the page is. Use it to find where an image came from, who published it first, or where it is reused without permission. Costs 1 credit.

image.description: Direct URL of the image file (http or https, not the web page showing it), or the absolute path to a local image file up to 20 MB.

max_results.description: Most pages to return, best ranked first.

name: reverse_image_search

matchingImages.description: URLs of the copies of the image on this page.

rank.description: Page prominence; lower is more prominent.

title: Reverse image search
